summary: Orchid Island Capital filed an 8-K to announce a monthly dividend declaration of $0.10 per share for July 2026, payable August 28, 2026 to holders of record July 31, 2026. The filing also notes the release dates for second quarter 2026 results and RMBS portfolio characteristics. This is a routine dividend declaration with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or activist campaign. No deal terms or structural changes are present. The filing is purely operational and informational, so no risk-arb angle applies.
